description: 对每包冻结恢复结果计算 DURA 接收作用伴随残差，学习共享结构的逐频点实增益；两套数据分别训练权重，并补 WiSig 实增益对照。

permissions.claim_scope: Source-only 2000-step U_s IQ paired training; no new F or TX label read. LoRa prior inherited previously authorized frozen E104 supervision and U pseudolabels. Source V label only after predictions. No target access.

checkpoint.initialization: Fresh zero output PhysicsGain independently per dataset; WiSig independent RealSpectralGain fresh zero output.

sources.role: LoRa fixed same-contract 36000-step real gain prior; pretrained with authorized source E104 and U pseudo labels
LoRa source-trained raw R02/R07 action; R17 screen comparator
WiSig U-only same-contract PacketUNet initialization for real gain control
WiSig same-contract fixed DURA v1 R69 source-final checkpoint; no LoRa cross-dataset checkpoint transfer

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Parent source records, fit-inputs, frozen proof and strict tensor load; PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Same-dataset source contracts only. LoRa real gain history includes E104 teacher, 0.95 U pseudo-CE, fixed 36000-step final; WiSig packet prior F-free U-only 1600 steps; R69 source-final E20/4940.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed 2000 source updates and final weights. Screen fixed two disjoint sample halves with seed 2026112852. Low urban fusion net vs each available control >=1 in each LoRa half or >=2 in each WiSig half; clean net >=-1 LoRa or >=-2 WiSig vs each. Report 2000 paired bootstrap intervals; promotion requires all conditions.

execution.gpu_policy: Three separate GPUs with >=8192 MiB free at launch; one task worker per GPU; preserve all other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop affected pipeline for missing/mismatched lawful input, checkpoint or data contract, nonfinite gradient, output collision, failed real-checkpoint no-query smoke, incomplete paired prediction or scorer failure. Preserve partial outputs and other owners.

notes: Screen receiver chosen by availability and original physical data protocol, not by test scores: LoRa b200_1 first source receiver; WiSig source RX1 first registered source RX with 360 source V records.
These source V panels and LoRa full results have prior exposure. The screen is developmental, not an independent target claim; future target formal evidence must disclose historical exposure.

LoRa comparator is the separately LoRa-trained native R17, not DURA v1.0; cross-dataset original DURA v1.0 checkpoint is not silently used. Same-contract v1.0-style matching control remains outstanding before a full acceptance claim.
WiSig real gain is separately trained from scratch on WiSig using a source-only WiSig PacketUNet parent; no LoRa parameters or TX labels transferred.

The paired physical samples and two views are frozen before the independent CPU scorer opens source V labels. Final seven-scene target test has not been authorized by this screen until per-dataset promotion.

No new teacher, pseudolabel or class training is used by these gain fits. Inherited LoRa parent used frozen E104 and accepted source clean U pseudo labels; inherited training costs are not included in new optimizer seconds.
